variable_scope: Variable Scope Additions in This Phase
Enable 3 early adopters through solution design, provisioning, implementation, and operational validation
objective: Industrialize the Fabric platform foundation by automating repeatable platform services, operationalizing governance and support, and onboarding early-adopter teams through standardized patterns that demonstrate the platform can repeatedly onboard, govern, and support qualified workloads.
activities_work_products_table: Validate architecture through EA workloads, design reviews, and performance testing
Refine reusable reference patterns for ingestion, data engineering, analytics, AI, and cross-platform consumption
Align with Microsoft on roadmap dependencies and platform capability gaps
Automate workspace provisioning, access, environment configuration, and deployment processes
Implement centralized monitoring, logging, alerting, operational dashboards, and production controls
Expand reusable templates, Infrastructure as Code, and platform automation for repeated delivery
Operationalize governance policies, access model, metadata standards, and data classification
Define platform ownership, decision rights, support tiers, service levels, and capacity governance
Establish cost transparency and chargeback approach
Support Model, Service Levels & Cost Transparency Model
Launch standardized intake and onboarding for early adopters
Onboard early-adopter workloads with role-based training, documentation, and office hours
Capture feedback, lessons learned, and enhancements in the platform backlog
assumptions: 3 Early-adopter teams and workloads are confirmed at the start of Phase 02
UHG provides timely access to required data, environments, SMEs, and approval forums
Scope and duration may vary based on the number, complexity, and production-readiness requirements of early-adopter workloads
